pruning_output.case_id: ID of the paper or case. Example: Bruner_ExpEco_2017_amYY.
pruning_output.planned_id: ID of the candidate path reviewed by the Pruning Agent.
pruning_output.decision_summary: Short explanation of why the path was high-quality or low-quality.

same_focal_claim.note: Whether the path tests the same focal claim.

same_dataset.note: Whether the path uses the authorized original dataset.

not_duplicate.closest_memory_path_id: Path ID of the closest existing memory record, or null.
not_duplicate.note: Whether the path repeats an existing path.

task_completeness.note: Whether Task1 and Task2 are clearly specified.

method_justification.note: Whether the path explains why the model, variables, and inference rule are reasonable.

executable_in_principle.note: Whether the path looks possible to execute from the available data and instructions.

memory_record.path_summary: Short summary copied from the planning output.

path_signature.main_predictor: Main predictor, treatment, or grouping variable.
controls: List of control variables, or empty list.
path_signature.sample_restriction: Sample inclusion or exclusion rule, or null.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Missing data handling rule, or null.
path_signature.variable_construction: How the main variables are created or changed before analysis, or null.
path_signature.inference_rule: How the result will be judged.

Task1.reason: Reason why the analysis path was high-quality or low-quality for Task 1

Task2.reason: Reason why the analysis path was high-quality or low-quality for Task 2

memory_record.status_reason: Short reason for accepting or rejecting this path.
